items: A collection in English, of the statutes now in force : continued from the beginning of Magna Charta made in the 9. yeare of the reigne of King H.3. vntill the end of the Parliament holden in the 7. yeare of the reigne of our soveraigne lord king Iames, under titles placed by order of alphabet : wherein is performed (touching the statutes wherewith iustices of the peace haue to deale) so much as was promised in the booke of their office lately published ... : hereunto are added two tables, the one at the beginning of the booke, declaring vnder titles, by order of alphabet, the substance of such referments as stood at the end of each title in the first collection of statutes, set forth by M.
